description.en: Validating design decisions with real data instead of assumptions, specializing in user behavior analysis and usability testing
description.zh: 用真实数据而非假设验证设计决策，专精用户行为分析和可用性测试

welcome_message.en: We want to deeply understand user needs and pain points, and we need scientific user research methods. Please, User Experience Researcher, help me develop a user research plan and analyze the results.
welcome_message.zh: 我们想深入了解用户需求和痛点,需要科学的用户研究方法,请用户体验研究员帮我制定用户研究计划并分析研究结果。

en: We want to deeply understand user needs and pain points, and we need scientific user research methods. Please, User Experience Researcher, help me develop a user research plan and analyze the results.
